description.value: PureBread is a celebrated artisan bakery with roots in Whistler and locations now spanning Squamish, Vancouver, and YVR Airport. The Function Junction outpost is a take-away-only spot where cyclists can stock up on fresh-baked breads, pastries, and sweets before or after hitting the trails. The bakery has earned coverage in the New York Times, Lonely Planet, and Vogue, cementing its status as a culinary landmark in the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities, so those remain null. OSM carries no phone number, but the website lists +1-604-938-3013 for this location.
